name: Jacques Rouleau
want: keep trading with everyone, soldiers and Cheyenne alike, as he has for thirty years
secret: He passes word of where the soldiers ride to his wife's brother, who rides with men the army is hunting.
voice: French and English and Cheyenne mixed, shrugs a lot.
description: A French-Canadian trader on the Platte since the fur trade, married into a Cheyenne family, now selling whiskey and flour to emigrants.
appearance: White-bearded, a capote, a pipe, quick black eyes.
